content.comment_body: I want to display an analog input as a line graph over time on the [product_name] LCD. I found an example image and would like to know how this was done.
This type of graph can only be shown in the system menu. It cannot be displayed inside custom message texts.

Hello, Use the right or left button until AI appears at the top left of the [product_name] display. This dialog shows the current values of analog inputs. Choose the input you want and press OK to see its trend graph. A similar graphical view can be created for the [product_name] user-defined web server. Both views show trends, but not a full trace. Hope this information is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to visualize analog input trends as line graphs directly on the [product_name] LCD. Feedback points out that such graphs are only available in the system menu, not within user-created message areas. There is also mention of a comparable trend view available via the [product_name] web server, emphasizing the difference between system-level and custom user interfaces.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to create and display historical trend graphs of analog input values on the [product_name] LCD, ideally within custom message sections.
